lead: Shimmering text for short labels such as "Thinking" or "Generating": the text is muted, with an identical copy on top that shows a highlight only within the glyphs, sweeping from left to right in a loop. With "reduced motion" the highlight is hidden and the text is solid.

states.title: Active and finished
states.description: With `active` off it is plain muted text, e.g. once thinking has ended.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.label: The copy of the text that screen readers read
styling.highlight: The identical text on top (`aria-hidden`), showing the highlight only within the glyphs; hidden with reduced motion
